title: Frontier Risk Report (February to March 2026) (metr, 2026-05-19)
abstract: [metr-claude-opus-4-6-independent-eval] A non-exhaustive sampling of benchmarks that were saturated or plausibly very close to saturation: TerminalBench 2.0 (GPT-5.5 got ~82%), SWE-Bench Verified (Mythos Preview got ~94%), WeirdML (GPT-5.5 got ~84%), Cybench (Claude Mythos Preview got 100% according to Sec 3.3.1 of the System Card), CyberGym (Claude Mythos Preview got ~83%), LiveCodeBench Pro (Gemini 3 Deep Think gets ~82%).
